no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-03-26): in September 2025 management strategically pivoted away from prescription drug development to OTC/cosmetic skincare distribution. The lead Rx asset XYNGARI (DMT310) — which had reported positive Phase 3 STAR-1 results in March 2025 — is no longer being developed as a prescription product. No active P1/P2/P3 clinical-stage pipeline remains; planned products are cosmetic/OTC (not under FDA NDA pathway).

website.note: Pipeline page shows only OTC 'Acne Kit' (not a clinical asset); pipeline image dated September 2025

ctgov.note: All 6 trials are completed/unknown status; no active clinical-stage trials

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 3 STAR-1 successful (March 2025), but Rx development discontinued in September 2025 per strategic pivot to OTC/cosmetic. Asset to be re-purposed as OTC cosmetic, no NDA pathway.
